hypotheses.name: Calibrated bridge-curvature rewiring rescue
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth run across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {0,3,7,11}; added bridge-curvature descriptors on top of H70 and evaluated degree-preserving, degree+length-bin, degree+length+bridge-strata rewiring, plus label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.07852; positive rows=24/24; positive mean domain-splits=6/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this additive bridge-curvature utility lineage as a primary branch unless a materially different endpoint (non-additive, non-AUROC-lift objective) is introduced.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Two consecutive runs (H95 then stricter H97) show strong directional lift but 0/6 positive mean null-gap domain-splits.

hypotheses.name: Multi-radius ID heterogeneity entropy screen
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth run across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {0,3,7,11}; added node/edge ID entropy and heterogeneity features over radii k={4,6,8,10,12} on top of H70, with radius-order permutation, neighborhood-assignment shuffle, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=-0.00773; positive rows=5/24; positive mean domain-splits=1/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Do not continue standalone/additive ID-entropy utility screens; if revisited, test interaction-only terms on top of robust topology features.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Current standalone/additive intrinsic-dimensionality utility formulation remains non-robust and below baseline.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model GO-module role-graph alignment
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot across immune/lung/external_lung and layers {7,11}; built GO-module role vectors from scGPT and Geneformer, compared module role-graph transition concordance, and tested module-membership permutation, role-label permutation, and random-subspace rotation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.03934; positive concordance rows=5/6; mean null-gap(q95)=-0.02497; positive null-gap domains=0/3
hypotheses.next_action: Keep cross-model alignment retired unless a fundamentally new shared residual-level supervision view is available.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Structural-reset rescue still failed null robustness in all domains (0/3 positive mean null-gap).
